create_item.description: Add an item to a collection, such as a blog post, a product or a lead from a form, with a value for each field you fill in.
create_item.display_str_template: Add an item to Directus collection {0}.
create_item.name: create_item

parameters.description: The collection to work with, such as posts. Pick it from the list, or type its name or paste a link to it from the Data Studio.
parameters.name: collection

parameters.description: A value for each field to fill in. Fields left blank get their default. For a file or image field, give the ID that Upload file returns; for a related item, its ID.
parameters.name: fields

collection.description: The collection it's in, such as posts

id.description: The item's ID (its primary key), as text

item.description: The item's fields and values, by field name, such as {"id": 12, "title": "Hello", "status": "published"}

link.description: Where to open it in the Directus Data Studio

create_or_update_item.description: Update the item whose value in the field you match on is the one given, such as a lead with this email address, or add it if there is none, so a workflow that runs twice never adds it twice.
create_or_update_item.display_str_template: Add or update an item in Directus collection {0}, matched on {1}.
create_or_update_item.name: create_or_update_item

parameters.description: The collection to work with, such as posts. Pick it from the list, or type its name or paste a link to it from the Data Studio.
parameters.name: collection

parameters.description: The field that tells items apart, such as email. Give its value in Fields; its values should be unique.
parameters.name: match_field

parameters.description: A value for each field to fill in, including the one to match on. An existing item keeps the fields left blank. For a file or image field, give the ID that Upload file returns; for a related item, its ID.
parameters.name: fields

collection.description: The collection it's in, such as posts

created.description: True if the item was added, false if an existing one was updated

id.description: The item's ID (its primary key), as text

item.description: The item's fields and values, by field name, such as {"id": 12, "title": "Hello", "status": "published"}

link.description: Where to open it in the Directus Data Studio

delete_file.description: Delete a file from Directus's file library, for good.
delete_file.name: delete_file

parameters.description: The file's ID, from Upload file or an item's file field, or its link copied from the file library.
parameters.name: file_id

deleted.description: True once the file is deleted

delete_item.description: Delete one item of a collection, for good.

parameters.description: The collection to work with, such as posts. Pick it from the list, or type its name or paste a link to it from the Data Studio.

find_items.description: Find the items of a collection whose field matches a value, or that contain some words, sorted the way you choose. Leave the filter blank to list them all, a page at a time.
find_items.name: find_items

parameters.description: The collection to work with, such as posts. Pick it from the list, or type its name or paste a link to it from the Data Studio.
parameters.name: collection

parameters.description: Only items whose value in this field passes the filter. A related item's field can be named with a dot, such as author.email.
parameters.name: filter_field

parameters.description: How the field's value is compared. Contains ignores upper and lower case.
parameters.name: filter_operator

parameters.description: The value to compare with. For Is one of, give the values separated by commas.
parameters.name: filter_value

parameters.description: A Directus filter in JSON, for several conditions at once, such as {"status": {"_eq": "published"}, "views": {"_gt": 100}}. Used together with Filter by field.
parameters.name: advanced_filter

parameters.description: Only items with these words in any of their text fields.
parameters.name: search

parameters.description: The field to sort the items by. Leave blank for the collection's own order.
parameters.name: sort_field

parameters.description: Sort from highest to lowest (newest first, Z to A).
parameters.name: descending

parameters.description: The most items to return, up to 1000. Defaults to 100.
parameters.name: limit

parameters.description: Which page of results to return, starting at 1.
parameters.name: page

parameters.description: Return only these fields. Leave empty for all of them. A related item's field can be named with a dot, such as author.first_name.
parameters.name: return_fields

ids.description: The IDs of the items listed, as text

items.description: The items that match, each with its fields by name

total.description: How many items match in all, across every page

upload_file.description: Add a file to Directus's file library, such as an image or a PDF, to put in an item's file or image field with its ID.
upload_file.name: upload_file

parameters.description: The file: upload one, pick one from an earlier step, or give a public https link to download.
parameters.name: file

parameters.description: What the file is called in the library. Defaults to one made from its name.
parameters.name: title

parameters.description: The library folder to put it in. Leave blank for the top of the library.
parameters.name: folder

asset_url.description: Its address for download; needs a token unless the Public role may read files

folder.description: The ID of the folder it's in; empty for the top of the library

height.description: An image's height in pixels; 0 for other files

id.description: The file's ID; put it in a file or image field to attach it

link.description: Where to open it in the Data Studio's file library

type.description: Its type, such as image/png or application/pdf

width.description: An image's width in pixels; 0 for other files

description: Keep your Directus content and data up to date: add items to any collection from forms and other apps, update them or add-or-update one matched by a field such as email, find and read them, and upload files. Start a workflow when an item is added or changed.

directus_item_updated_trigger.description: Runs when an item in a Directus collection is changed, with what it holds now. The collection needs a field Directus stamps with the date an item was updated. Changes made before the workflow was turned on don't start it.

output.collection: The collection the item is in
output.id: The item's ID (its primary key), as text
output.item: The item's fields and values, by field name
output.link: Where to open the item in the Directus Data Studio

parameters.description: The collection to watch for items changed, such as posts.
parameters.name: collection

directus_new_item_trigger.description: Runs when an item is added to a Directus collection, such as a new post, order or form entry, with all its fields. Items already there when the workflow is turned on don't start it.

output.collection: The collection the item is in
output.created_at: When it was added (ISO 8601); empty if the collection doesn't record it
output.id: The item's ID (its primary key), as text
output.item: The item's fields and values, by field name
output.link: Where to open the item in the Directus Data Studio

parameters.description: The collection to watch for items added, such as posts.
parameters.name: collection
